fields.description: Boulevard Park is Wasl’s residential collection between the park and retail boulevard at Wasl Gate in Jebel Ali. Its published layouts range from studios and apartments to duplexes, penthouses and multilevel townhouses.

research.locationNote: Wasl Gate, Jebel Ali, near Energy Metro Station. Property Finder’s Al Wasl prose is inconsistent with the developer’s location.
overview: Wasl describes 1,248 planned homes across two plots. This is a development count, not available stock.
research.priceNote: Property Finder’s AED 900,000 launch reference concerns studios. No current developer price list or unit-specific quotation was retrieved.
research.paymentNote: Reference split: 10% booking, 50% construction, 40% handover. Broker calendars differ; no original developer payment sheet or family-wide signed schedule was verified.
research.handoverNote: Branded brochure: Q4 2029; Property Finder: June 2029. Confirm the selected building’s contractual date.
